turns.content: After supper, I pull out a worn deck of cards and shuffle. "Anyone want to lose some coppers?"

Brennic: *eyes light up, copper-bright in the firelight* "Lose? Me? Deal."
Tobbe: *settles down, the log groaning under him* "Tobbe plays. Tobbe does not know the rules."
Mira: "I have read three books on games of chance, and I believe I understand the probabilities well, though I have never actually played."
I deal out the cards and explain the rules. A few rounds later, Tobbe has a large pile of coins. "Tobbe, how are you winning?"

Tobbe: *beams* "Tobbe does not know. Tobbe just likes the pretty ones."
Brennic: *squinting at him* "Pit-fighter face. Never moves. Unfair advantage."
Mira: *scribbling numbers on a scrap* "It should not be possible, statistically, unless he is extraordinarily lucky, which I suppose he is."
I catch Brennic slipping a card into his sleeve. "Brennic. Sleeve."

Brennic: *produces the card with a crooked grin* "Habit. Twelve years on the river. Hands do things."
Tobbe: *knocks on the log solemnly* "Cheating brings bad luck."
Mira: "I would like to know how you did that, purely for academic reasons, because I did not see it at all."
